name: a search-shed is a full hold again
why: The old port: a shed wrote cool, so every script's lookups in every tab stopped for a refusal of searches.
grep: S1: a search-shed 503 holds searches only

name: a shed steps hot
why: A shed is MusicBrainz's search load, not our pace; stepping hot would lengthen every later hold for everyone.

edits.replace:
if (mono >= scool) s.shot = Math.min((s.shot || 0) + 1, 6);
                    s.hot = Math.min((s.hot || 0) + 1, 6);

grep: S1: a search-shed 503 holds searches only

name: a search books past scool
why: A search booked inside a shed goes straight into another 503.

edits.find:
o.search ? _mbGateHoldEnd(s.scool, now, mono, _mbgScoolSeen) : -Infinity);
            const cool = now + (end - mono);

grep: S10: a search booked inside a shed

name: a waiting search ignores a new scool
why: A shed that begins while a search waits must still hold it (the wait loop re-reads both holds).
grep: S11: a shed that begins while a search waits

name: a lookup waits out scool too
why: Lookups and browses go on during a shed; holding them is the old full stop by another road.

edits.find:
const end = Math.max(_mbGateHoldEnd(s.cool, now, mono),
                o.search ?
edits.replace:
const end = Math.max(_mbGateHoldEnd(s.cool, now, mono),
                true ?

name: _mbGateFetch marks no search
why: Without the marker the two gated searches (length batch, event release-group lookup) never meet scool, and their shed becomes a full hold.

name: no jitter
why: Without the spread every waiter of every tab leaves on the same millisecond into a fresh 503 (#1112).

name: global steps hot
why: A global 503 is MusicBrainz's own load; stepping hot slowed every later page (#1095).

name: a Retry-After is multiplied by hot
why: The old rule: Retry-After 2 s at hot 3 held every script 6 s where upstream holds 2 s.

edits.find: const grow = load || raw != null ? 1 : Math.max(1, s.hot || 0);

grep: S6: a Retry-After is not multiplied by hot

name: a hold never grows with hot
why: Without a Retry-After a run of throttles must get longer holds, or a busy spell gets as many requests as a quiet one.

edits.find: const grow = load || raw != null ? 1 : Math.max(1, s.hot || 0);

grep: S6: a Retry-After is not multiplied by hot

name: shot never steps back
why: A clean search answer must take a step of the shed counter back, as upstream does.

why: Only a search's clean answer says the shed eased; a lookup's says nothing about searches.
